title: AWS announces agentic account creation for agentic coding harnesses
summary: Discover more about what's new at AWS with AWS announces agentic account creation for agentic coding harnesses
body_markdown:
AWS now enables agentic coding harnesses to open the new AWS sign-up experience for developers who don't have an AWS account yet. Previously, developers working in agentic coding environments like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor had to manually navigate to[aws.amazon.com](https://aws.amazon.com/) , sign up for an AWS account and configure credentials before deploying workloads, interrupting the developer's experience. Now, developers can go from an idea to deploying a running application by the browser automatically opening, completing sign up and returning short-lived credentials to the harness.


When developers sign up for AWS from their coding agent, they start with the new AWS experience. Their first project comes set up with a home Region, IAM role manager, and short-term credentials that refresh automatically, so the agent can start deploying right away.


To try the new experience, install the AWS plugin or configure the AWS Agent Toolkit in your agentic coding harness. To learn more, see the[AWS Agent Toolkit documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/agent-toolkit/latest/userguide/) or the[AWS Account Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/accounts/latest/reference/accounts-welcome.html) .
